# requireConsistent2DArray

<link-summary>Returns the value as a matrix with uniform row lengths, or throws naming the offending row.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireConsistent2DArray() — Returns the value as a matrix with uniform row lengths, or throws naming the offending row. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/array</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireConsistent2DArray<T>(value: unknown, message?: string): T[][];
```

The strict counterpart of [`require2DArray`](require2DArray.md): the value must be a non-empty array of arrays
**and** every row must be as wide as the first.

When the rows differ, the default message reports the offending row and both widths — the information needed to fix
the call, and precisely what `Range#setValues` withholds when it rejects a ragged matrix. A custom `message`
replaces the default in both failure cases.

## Parameters

| Parameter              | Type      | Description                                                                    |
| :--------------------- | :-------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `value`                | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                                         |
| `message` _(optional)_ | `string`  | The exception message. A default describing the mismatch is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`T[][]` — the same value, typed as a two-dimensional array.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                                     |
| :------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | The value is not a non-empty array of arrays. |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | The rows do not all have the same length.     |

## Examples

### A matrix that is safe to write

<tabs group="code">
<tab title="TypeScript" group-key="ts">
<code-block lang="typescript" src="requireConsistent2DArray.ts" include-symbol="writeMatrix"/>
</tab>
<tab title="JavaScript" group-key="js">
<code-block lang="javascript">
function writeMatrix(sheet, values) {
  const rows = requireConsistent2DArray(values);
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, rows.length, rows[0].length).setValues(rows);
}
</code-block>
</tab>
</tabs>

### The message names the offending row

```javascript
requireConsistent2DArray([
  [1, 2],
  [3, 4]
]); // => [[1, 2], [3, 4]]

requireConsistent2DArray([[1, 2], [3]]);
// throws IllegalArgumentException:
// Expected every row to have 2 columns, but row 1 has 1.

requireConsistent2DArray([1, 2], "rows must be a matrix");
// throws IllegalArgumentException: rows must be a matrix
```
